svg.title: DIA-204 · The late arrival
svg.desc: A metro platform at night, drawn as a transport poster in flat shapes and one-point perspective. A large split-flap indicator board hangs over the platform. Under DEPARTURES it lists THE MODEL, departed; ITS SUCCESSOR, departed; THE ONE AFTER, boarding. Under ARRIVALS it lists REPORT OF HARM FROM THE FIRST, 18 months late, picked out in rust; and THE REGULATOR'S RESPONSE, delayed: years. Down the tunnel the two red tail lamps of the train that has just left are receding. On the empty lit platform stand a suitcase and a holdall.
svg.text: PART II · DELAYS, BRAKES, AND ENGINE SPEED

g.text: REPORT OF HARM FROM THE FIRST
the train the report is about

svg.text: DIA-204 · The report of harm pulls in two trains after the one that caused it.
